category_note: Hybrid: kinetic-type backbone wrapping a hand-authored, GENERIC stylized UI demo (no capture, no real site). Not the search-driven `webpage` category: nothing is captured, the browser + job-offer page are invented placeholders built in HTML/CSS.
style: Premium, mysterious then obvious. Same identity as the Alice launch film: warm cream ground, near-black Geist headlines, ONE green accent (#006045), soft tinted cards (4% fill / 20% border / 12-14px radius), pill chrome, NO shadows (except a very soft drop under the browser window to lift it off the ground, max 0 24px 60px rgba(26,25,24,0.08)). Calm, precise, confident motion: power3/expo outs, no bounce, no glitch. Atmosphere (concentric rings) only on hook and lockup.

build_constraints.offline_render: The render browser has NO network. Do NOT reference any CDN or Google Fonts. Replace the scaffold's jsdelivr GSAP <script> with <script src="assets/vendor/gsap.min.js"></script>. Load Geist with @font-face from assets/fonts/*.woff2 (font-display: block). No remote images; every icon is inline SVG.
build_constraints.index_html: Rewrite the scaffold index.html for 1080x1920 (viewport meta, html/body and #stage sizes, data-width=1080 data-height=1920, data-duration=12). Background #FAFAF8.
build_constraints.registry_blocks: If you `npx hyperframes add` a component, it lands in compositions/; after adding, grep it and replace any remote URL (fonts/CDN) with the local assets before rendering. If add fails offline, hand-author the same move inline — the components below are references, not hard dependencies.
build_constraints.no_third_party: No third-party logos, names or UI (no LinkedIn/Indeed/Welcome to the Jungle/Chrome/Safari look-alikes). Browser chrome is generic: three neutral dots, a neutral URL pill reading « emplois.exemple/offre/2481 », one extension slot holding Alice's eyes. Company on the offer page is a neutral placeholder.
build_constraints.no_dates_no_numbers: No launch date, no stats. Only « Bientôt ».
build_constraints.copy_language: All on-screen copy in French, exactly as written in content (typographic apostrophes ’, non-breaking space before « . » punctuation where relevant: « Bientôt. » has none needed).
build_constraints.seek_safe: One paused GSAP timeline on window.__timelines["main"], fromTo with autoAlpha for delayed reveals, typed text via a proxy object + onUpdate writing textContent (deterministic slice), no Math.random / Date.now.

shot_brief: A quiet cream frame; Alice's two green rings draw themselves open like eyes waking up and « Bientôt. » settles beneath them. The eyes shrink and fly into the toolbar of a generic, softly-stylized browser window that rises into frame on a job-offer page. The eyes icon lights up, a « Dossier prêt » side panel slides in, and the application form fills itself line by line — adapted CV attached, cover letter typed, answers written — while the viewer watches. A cursor (the user) presses « Envoyer », a green check pops: « Candidature envoyée ». The window falls away to pure kinetic type — « Postule avec ton compte. En un clic. » — then the reassurance « Tes identifiants ne quittent jamais ton ordinateur. », and resolves on the lockup: eyes, « L’extension Alice », a « Bientôt » pill and alice-agent.fr. Dominant motif: Alice's EYES — they open the film, become the toolbar icon that triggers everything, and close it in the lockup (a single blink at 11.1s).

scenes.motion: 1.40–2.00 browser window rises from y+180 with autoAlpha 0→1 and scale 0.96→1 (power3.out) while the eyes icon lands in its extension slot. 2.30 beat: eyes icon LIGHTS UP — desaturated→#006045, disc to #ECF4F0, a single soft halo ring (accent-medium) expands from the icon and fades (0.5s). 2.75 beat: side panel slides in from the window's right edge (x+380→0, 0.45s, expo.out — panel-reveal), its 3 rows stagger in (0.06s). Camera: 2.9–4.9 slow push-in on the form (whole UI layer scale 1→1.08, transformOrigin at the form's centre, sine.inOut). 3.10–4.85 fields fill top→bottom: each field's border flashes accent-medium as a caret enters, text types via proxy slice (≈28 chars/s; Nom 3.10, E-mail 3.40, CV chip pops 3.80 with scale_punch-lite 0.9→1, Lettre 4.00–4.45, Pourquoi 4.45–4.85); the matching side-panel row ticks its ✓ (check path draw 0.2s) as its field completes. 4.95–5.15 a dark neutral arrow cursor (the USER, not Alice) decel-arrives from bottom-right onto « Envoyer » (press-ripple). 5.15 beat: press — button + cursor compress to 0.96 together, ring ripple in accent-medium. 5.45 beat: form dims to 35% (white veil), success-check pops (ring scale 0→1 back.out(1.6) clamped, check draws 0.3s) with « Candidature envoyée » rising 16px. 5.45–6.35 hold (legibility). 6.35–6.60 exit: whole browser drops y+120 and fades (power2.in) — the transition into S3.
